articles.title: Russia’s largest bank Sberbank plans crypto trading infrastructure by December
articles.snippet: New regulations for crypto trading, custody, and settlement in Russia take effect Sept. 1, with requirements for licensed intermediaries applying from July 2027.

articles.title: North Korea arrests hackers accused of laundering stolen funds from country's bank via crypto
articles.snippet: The group allegedly breached Central Bank systems, converted crypto to cash via Chinese brokers, and used small transfers to evade detection.

articles.title: Democratizing weather derivatives through tokenization could be crypto's most important real-world use case
articles.snippet: Main Street, which faces the most significant climate-related financial risk, currently lacks an avenue to hedge weather-related risks, argues CoinDesk’s Omkar Godbole.

articles.title: Robinhood Chain's real-world assets jump fivefold as tokenized stocks start trading in bigger size
articles.snippet: The chain built to put equities onchain has tripled in size since mid-July, and a dozen tokenized stocks are now each clearing $500,000 a day. Real-world assets are growing fast, though memecoins and stablecoins still dominate the chain.

articles.title: Senate Dems should accept the victory they won on Trump's crypto limits: White House
articles.snippet: U.S. Senate Democrats got President Donald Trump to accept potential limits on his lucrative crypto dealings, but they say the Clarity Act's restrictions aren't enough.
